note: The one founder window (owner, 2026-10-16): the Founder Pack and the OC Hypercar Founder Edition are sold until the end of December 31, 2026, Pacific time (the Founder Pack then never again; what "never sold again" covers for the car, its Founder Edition exclusives or the car itself, is the owner's open decision, so the car's copy promises only the end date). It is the last second of that day in Pacific time, not the bare date: '2026-12-31' alone parses as midnight UTC, which is 4 pm Pacific on December 30. Founder items in catalog.json say "window": { "until": "FOUNDER_UNTIL" } and every reader resolves it from this file: the store (src/store/catalog.ts), the server's copy (tools/store-sync-catalog.mjs writes it into server/supabase/functions/_shared/catalog.json, where create-checkout and stripe-webhook read it) and the checker (tools/store-check-catalog.mjs). Never extend it once sales start.
